````` ::: ::: # Taxonomic curation The column `SUPERGROUP_18S` is close to the 18S rRNA gene tag-sequencing results to help us draw conclusions regarding the comparison. This curation is helpful for later comparison to 18S rRNA gene amplicon work, but we also need to perform manual curation. Pair taxonomic classification with full_classification. Below generates `long_frenemies_annot_tax`. Manual curation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} myzozoa <- c("Perkinsea", "Chromerida", "Colpodellida", "Colponemidia", "Apicomplexa", "Squirmida") # at phylum class_gyrista <- c("Bacillariophyceae","Bolidophyceae","Chrysophyceae", "Dictyochophyceae", "Eustigmatophyceae", "Ochromonadales","Pelagophyceae", "Xanthophyceae") class_bigyra <- c("Opalozoa", "Labyrinthulomycetes") long_frenemies_annot_tax <- long_frenemies_annot %>% filter(Domain == "Eukaryota") %>% # Alveolata mutate(SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM = case_when( (is.na(Supergroup)) ~ "Eukaryote-Unannotated", (grepl("_X", Phylum) | is.na(Phylum)) ~ paste(Supergroup, "Unannotated", sep = "-"), # Alveolata (Supergroup == "Alveolata" & (is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "Alveolata_X")) ~ "Alveolata-Unannotated", (Supergroup == "Alveolata" & Order == "Syndiniales") ~ "Alveolata-Syndiniales", Phylum %in% myzozoa ~ "Alveolata-Myzozoa", # Green algae Supergroup == "Rhodelphea" ~ "Archaeplastida-Rhodelphea", #Stramenopiles (Obiol et al. 2024 - https://academic.oup.com/femsec/article/100/11/fiae130/7815208) Class %in% class_gyrista ~ "Stramenopiles-Gyrista", Class %in% class_bigyra ~ "Stramenopiles-Bigyra", Phylum == "Synurophyceae" ~ "Stramenopiles-Gyrista", Phylum == "Oomycota" ~ "Stramenopiles-Gyrista", Phylum == "Marine_stramenopiles_MASTs group" ~ "Stramenopiles-Bigyra", Supergroup == "Eukaryota incertae sedis" ~ Phylum, Supergroup == "Haptista" ~ paste("Hacrobia", Phylum, sep = "-"), # Phylum == "Choanoflagellida" ~ "Opisthokonta-Choanoflagellata", # TRUE ~ paste(Supergroup, Phylum, sep = "-"))) %>% ### Continued mutate(SUPERGROUP_0 = case_when( grepl("Alveolata-", SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM) ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM, SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Unannotated eukaryote" ~ "Eukaryote-Unannotated", TRUE ~ str_split_i(SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM, "-", 1))) %>% ### mutate(SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_2 = case_when( # Dinoflagellates (SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Dinophyta" & (is.na(Class) | is.na(Order) | grepl("SG_", Order))) ~ "Dinophyta-Unannotated", SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Dinophyta" ~ paste("Dinophyta-", Order, sep = ""), # Myzozoa (SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Myzozoa" & (is.na(Class) | is.na(Order) | grepl("SG_", Order))) ~ "Myzozoa-Unannotated", SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Myzozoa" & Phylum %in% myzozoa ~ paste("Myzozoa-", Phylum, sep = "") )) %>% mutate(SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_CLASS = case_when( SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Ciliophora" ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_2, SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Myzozoa" ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_2, SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM == "Alveolata-Dinophyta" ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM_2, TRUE ~ SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM )) # The goal is to determine how the taxonomy curve maps against the KO function reference. When we select a taxonomic resolution that is "cherry-picked", we run the risk of have a less appropriate output. If the story changes when we change the taxonomic level, that can be alarming and not responsible. Ramond et al. (2025) looked at how decoupling is only credible if it survives across grain, not at one cherry-picked resolution. ## Set up Reload the handoff through `load_long_annot()` so the ladder sees exactly the table every later script sees (replicate-aware `sample_id`, `sample_unit`, `n_reps`). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} long <- load_long_annot() ``` ::: ### Build paired df Shared prep for 02–06 (`R/prep_paired.R`): Gorda Ridge, Von Damm and Piccard; no per-row TPM cutoff; multi-KO transcripts split with TPM divided equally; Eukaryota-only and Opisthokonta lineages dropped. `depth = NULL` because the ladder assigns its own depth at each step. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} paired <- prep_paired(long, depth = NULL) # head(paired) meta <- paired |> distinct(sample_id, sample_unit, field, vent_bin, n_reps) |> arrange(sample_id) # length((long$SEQ_ID)); length((paired$SEQ_ID)) length(unique(long$SEQ_ID)); length(unique(paired$SEQ_ID)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 295250 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 185578 ``` ::: ::: ### Set up the grain ladder Write a function to go through each taxonomic level. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Same transcripts at every depth: keep rows with a resolvable lineage, rm NAs paired_lin <- paired |> filter(!is.na(full_classification)) # Grain ladder runs on the curated taxonomy (02 manual curation; 2026-10-12) # depth 2 = curated supergroup, 3 = curated phylum (Syndiniales split from # Dinophyta), 4 = class-level taxon inside its curated phylum, 5+ = deeper real # ranks. See R/taxonomy_curated.R. cur_key <- paired_lin |> distinct(full_classification, SUPERGROUP_0, SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM) tax_at_depth <- function(d) { cur_key |> mutate(.tax = curated_lineage(full_classification, SUPERGROUP_0, SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM, d)) |> select(full_classification, .tax) } # deepest curated depth present max_depth <- max(stringr::str_count(tax_at_depth(99L)$.tax, ";") + 1L) # max_depth ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # dat - input taxonomy matrix # feat - input functional matrix # label - add a label for matrix used # Label grain - for the taxonomic level used. grain_fit <- function(dat, feat, label_matrix, label_grain) { tryCatch( # stop if error { # Build matrix for adonis2 fxn to run. bm <- build_matrix(dat, feat, min_tpm = 0, transform = params$transform) m <- meta[match(labels(bm$dist), meta$sample_id), ] # PERMANOVA function perm <- run_permanova(bm$dist, m, permutations = params$permutations, seed = params$seed) |> filter(.data$term %in% c("vent_bin", "field")) |> select(term, R2, p) # dispersion check following permanova disp <- c(vent_bin = betadisper_check(bm$dist, m$vent_bin)$dispersion_p, field = betadisper_check(bm$dist, m$field)$dispersion_p) # perm |> mutate(matrix = label_matrix, grain = label_grain, n_features = ncol(bm$mat), dispersion_p = disp[.data$term], skip_reason = NA_character_, .before = 1)}, error = function(e) { # if fails, stop. message(label_matrix, " grain ", label_grain, " skipped: ", conditionMessage(e)) tibble::tibble(matrix = label_matrix, grain = label_grain, term = NA_character_, R2 = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n_features = NA_integer_, dispersion_p = NA_real_, skip_reason = conditionMessage(e)) }) }
